name: Bauernhof-Ferienwohung Neuschwendterhof
beschreibung: The Neuschwendterhof in Ebbs offers holiday apartments on a working farm. The accommodations are modernly furnished and have their own entrance. The farm is home to cows, rabbits, and cats, which children can experience firsthand. A large garden with play equipment and lawns invites relaxation. The accommodation is a starting point for tours in the Kaisergebirge and to the Zahmen Kaiser. The village of Ebbs has shopping facilities and restaurants. The Neuschwendterhof is suitable for guests who want to combine a rural setting with comfort.
